name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: Events along a line. Each entry takes elements for its badge, date, title, description, extra content and marker. Vertical or horizontal, content on one side or alternating, the date beside the content or across the line; ring, number or dot markers, solid, dashed or pin connectors, and per-entry colors. Give entries dates to space them by time, draw gaps solid, dashed or dotted by length with labels, group by day, month or year, and mark the current entry; plus reversed order, loading placeholders and an empty state.
